description: This Java class defines the AllergyProperties component in the OpenMRS system. It provides methods to retrieve allergy-related concepts from global properties, utilizing dependency injection of core services.

classes.name: AllergyProperties
classes.description: A component that provides access to allergy-related concepts via global properties in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getConceptByGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a Concept object based on a specified global property name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getMildSeverityConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing mild allergy severity.

methods.name: getModerateSeverityConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing moderate allergy severity.

methods.name: getSevereSeverityConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing severe allergy severity.

methods.name: getFoodAllergensConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing food allergens.

methods.name: getDrugAllergensConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing drug allergens.

methods.name: getEnvironmentAllergensConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing environmental allergens.

methods.name: getAllergyReactionsConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing allergy reactions.

methods.name: getOtherNonCodedConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept for non-coded allergy details.

methods.name: getUnknownConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept representing unknown allergy information.
